repository.name: ry-ops/ResuMate
repository.description: AI-powered resume optimization tool that matches resumes to job descriptions and ensures ATS/LPS compatibility

implementation_status.summary: ResuMate has been implemented with all core features functional. The application has a complete frontend, backend proxy server, and Claude AI integration.

files_analyzed.notes: Full HTML structure with resume input, job description input, API key section, and results display
Comprehensive CSS with responsive design, card layouts, animations, and proper theming
Frontend JavaScript with file upload handling, state management, API calls, and result parsing/display
Express.js backend proxy server to avoid CORS issues when calling Claude API
Proper npm configuration with express and cors dependencies
Comprehensive documentation with features, installation, usage instructions

required.implementation: Full vanilla JS implementation with modern HTML5/CSS3
File upload (PDF, DOC, DOCX, TXT) and textarea paste both implemented

required.requirement: Job description upload and paste functionality
required.implementation: Same file upload and paste options as resume input

required.requirement: Claude AI API integration for analysis
required.implementation: Backend proxy calls Claude API (claude-2.1 model) with structured prompts
Claude prompt includes ATS compatibility analysis with score
Mentioned in README and part of Claude analysis prompt
Requires Node.js server for API proxy (CORS limitation)
CSS includes responsive breakpoints and mobile-friendly layouts
Clean card-based UI with clear sections and visual feedback

deliverables.notes: All core functionality implemented and working
package.json shows 'Tests coming soon', no test files present
Detailed README with prerequisites, installation, and usage

security_considerations.notes: API key stored in localStorage, never sent to third-party servers, only to Anthropic
Backend proxy prevents API key exposure in browser network tab
Server validates required fields, but no sanitization of inputs

commit_history.development_pattern: Multiple iterations to fix API compatibility issues (tried Claude 3 Sonnet, Claude 3 Opus, settled on Claude 2.1)

gaps_and_recommendations.recommendation: Add unit tests for app.js functions and integration tests for server.js API endpoints
Update to Claude 3.5 Sonnet (claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022) with proper API version (2023-06-01 works) for better analysis
Add progress steps or estimated time during Claude API analysis
Add ability to export analysis results as PDF or copy to clipboard
Allow users to save previous analyses in localStorage
Add API endpoint documentation for server.js
Add Dockerfile or cloud deployment configs (Vercel, Railway, etc.)

conclusion.summary: ResuMate is a substantially complete web application that successfully implements all core requirements. The app provides resume upload/paste, job description matching, Claude AI analysis, and ATS/LPS compatibility scanning. The main gaps are lack of tests and use of an older Claude model.
next_steps: Add test suite with Jest or Vitest
Upgrade to Claude 3.5 Sonnet for better analysis
Add export and history features for better UX
conclusion.ready_for_production: Yes, with caveats - needs tests before production deployment
